newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FNB says 50 mln rand loss on Profurn sale.
newsitem.headline: FNB says 50 mln rand loss on Profurn sale.

text.p: First National Bank Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday its sale of Protea Furnishers Ltd's debtors book back to that firm will result in a loss to the bank of around 50 million rand in the second half of the year.

"The Profurn book has been sold...with effect from April 1, 1997. Resulting losses are estimated to be in the region of 50 million rand and will be reflected in the second half of the financial year," FNB said in a statement.
It was announced last month that Profurn had repurchased its furniture financing business, including the debtors' book and staff, from FNB for about 270 million rand.
The transaction sees FNB becoming Profurn's largest shareholder with a 22 percent stake.
FNB, battling with hefty bad debts, last year also sold a portion of its FirstPref debt financing unit back to McCarthy Retail Ltd in December last year. The date of the transfer was April 1, 1997.
FNB said on Wednesday losses in the FirstPref operation totalled 136.8 million rand.
